source: Legacy (pre-S1, unversioned) addresses, view codes, view:v4 / view:v5 payloads, views:v1 entries and history:v1 payloads, written from the grammar of the baseline 8c82ca1 (maps/persistence.md section 1.2 and 1.6, explorer.js viewParams/readView/checkView), not captured from users (O-11).
notes: Expected values are hand-derived from the baseline grammar: 2026-09-24T00:00Z is base column 3213312 (T0 1609459200 s, 56.25 s per column, 16 columns = 15 minutes), so 12:00Z is 3214080, 08:15Z is 3213840, 10:30Z is 3213984, 10:45Z is 3214000; 125 USDT per row, so 64000..66000 is rows 512..528 and 65000.5 is 520.004; the recorded cutoff is column 3214083. The percent-encoded codes use the baseline writer's own expression, encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(x)). The v2 column of addresses.json is the address this build writes for the same view under the canonical order of API.md B.15.
